title: carrier
description: The general underlying object an algebraic structure is built on: a G_s-coalgebra in the sheaf topos R = Sh(T,J), with stepping maps γ_t : X(t) → X(s★t) satisfying counit and coassociativity. The forward pole of the Passage duality. An ordinary SET is the degenerate carrier (constant sheaf, trivial stepping) — so the 'set' used by magma is a shadow of this.

sheaf.description: the underlying sheaf X in R = Sh(T,J)

stepping-map.description: γ : X → G_s(X), components γ_t natural in t (counit + coassociativity)
